Rank 2 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 15 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Weapon's Range
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: Yes

You make a jumping strike meant to deal maximum damage. This attack can only be used against a Prone Target. If you would make cast this technique using a Thrown weapon, you ignore any forms of detriments to your attack roll due to range (including disadvantage).

Roll a Combo Attack Roll dealing 2x your Weapon Damage Die on a success.

system.requirements: 1 *Simple or Martial Melee Weapon* that you are proficient with.
